_comment: Forces Vercel to build the Next.js app in ./frontend regardless of cached dashboard settings. Corepack picks pnpm@10.33.0 via the root package.json's packageManager field, then we cd into frontend. --no-frozen-lockfile so a slightly drifted lockfile doesn't abort the build.
installCommand: corepack enable && cd frontend && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
